name: site.checkbox/checkbox
title: Checkbox: subscription auto-renewal law checks
description: Auto-renewal law checks for Stripe Checkout: ROSCA, state laws (FTC click to cancel rule vacated)

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Clients that implement MCP OAuth sign in without it (browser approval). Otherwise Bearer <Checkbox API key> (ck_test_… or ck_live_…).

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: Free checks of subscription checkouts (Stripe Checkout, Payment Links), terms, online cancellation flows and renewal reminder emails against U.S. auto-renewal laws (FTC ROSCA and the laws of 27 states, DC and New York City, including California and New York), with corrected Stripe Checkout parameters, disclosure text and email templates. Not legal advice.

environmentVariables.name: CHECKBOX_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Checkbox API key (ck_test_… or ck_live_…). Without it, the setup_checkbox tool returns an approval link for the human, then test-mode keys. Free at https://app.checkbox.site/sign-up
